title: Can you get the car?
instructions: Annesi Can'a kısa bir mesaj bırakıyor. Ne yapması gerektiğine ve saate dikkat et.

script.speaker: mum
script.text: Can, it's Mum. The car is ready at the garage.

script.speaker: mum
script.text: Can you pick it up before five? The garage closes at half past five.

script.speaker: mum
script.text: The keys are on the kitchen table. Don't forget your driving licence!

questions.evidence: The car is ready at the garage.

questions.prompt: What time does the garage close?
questions.feedback: Tamirhane beş buçukta kapanıyor; Can beşten önce almalı.

The keys are on the kitchen table.
